entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that implements a universal memory layer supporting User, Session, and Agent states. It features multi-signal retrieval and temporal reasoning, available via managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It employs three-tier loading to reduce token usage and archives sessions through background extraction and compilation.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: A self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It builds graphs from text and code and supports automatic routing for vector, graph, and code retrieval.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for OpenClaw/Hermes Agents that creates knowledge graphs with typed edges without requiring LLM calls. It supports multi-user company setups with scoped data access and provides synthesized answers with gap analysis and citations.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication for sub-300ms recall. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from code, images, PDFs, and videos.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system focused on retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent learning. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, deployable via Docker or Kubernetes.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A stateful agent memory library that uses background reasoning to update peer representations from session history. It integrates with MCP and Claude Code, offering deployment options via managed service, local CLI, or Docker.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repository, using markdown context trees with commit, branch, and merge versioning. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents utilizing a single SQLite database and one pure-Python dependency. It achieves sub-millisecond performance and features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that combines Qdrant persistent memory, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive context harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts such as traces, reports, and context bundles. It utilizes outcome-gated promotion to update context based on verified trials.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specific recall tools, including lcm_grep and lcm_recall, for detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from over 20 different coding agents to provide millisecond lookups over months of past data. It utilizes MCP recall for high-speed searches across gigabytes of history while redacting sensitive keys and tokens for safety.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports flexible inference by connecting to any OpenAI-compatible provider or local LLM server.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur provides a shared memory layer that stores knowledge locally as human-readable YAML engrams. It uses hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context across global, team, and project-specific scopes.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer achieves 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It automates memory construction from Discord, Obsidian, and office documents, integrating directly with Hermes Agent and Claude Code via plugins.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, and integrates with agents through MCP and dedicated hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. It offers a specialized Hermes adapter and supports cross-platform deployment on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable memory recall by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result and tracking contradictions. It manages the memory lifecycle through consolidation passes and can run either as an embedded process or an HTTP backend.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, allowing agents to autonomously evolve persistent, source-grounded archives. It preserves temporal memory and citations without the need for a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by watching agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that automates configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for every query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified context files to reduce prompt token usage by 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal for information retrieval. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this project uses local BM25 tool ranking to minimize prompt tokens for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents across different platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to surface high-priority memories through 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to manage named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation performed by the agent.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments using USDC across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys for streamlined financial transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation to facilitate capability routing. It registers five native tools for searching and reporting artifact usage while automatically generating routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin uses a local SQLite reliability layer and write outbox for state persistence. It enables pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain continuity across agent interactions.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the accuracy of manual and automated memory retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool adds deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing private local code repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and provides LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A and file reads.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filtering and MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It further supports agent efficiency by implementing automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit implements a file-based memory hygiene loop that uses a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage without requiring a database. It features dedicated 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, providing evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for Hermes Agent. It exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4, utilizing the DeepSeek Harness for its agent runtime.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and NIST AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and is accessible via CLI or MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project facilitates natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution. It functions as a master router that integrates delegated permissions and x402 payments into a single skill.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content through a two-pass editing process to eliminate detectable AI patterns. It features Rewrite, Detect, and Edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for professional or technical contexts.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state directly within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,174 professional skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. Distributed as human-readable markdown files under the MIT license, it provides ready-to-paste exports for multiple AI assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin grants agents the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage new skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to generate documentation that combines prose, diagrams, and source code in .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source code edits back into the original literate document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through Lite or Full complexity modes. It incorporates a formal spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to verify project handoffs.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first, Git-based harness for long-running agents that operates without a background service. It utilizes a three-layer architecture consisting of a mechanism kernel, plugins, and Markdown recipes to implement the SLP cooperative-agent protocol.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides, configuration documentation, and skills formatted for the agentskills.io standard in Portuguese. It serves as a localized hub for integrating and deploying Hermes Agent capabilities.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables agent discovery and activation for blockchain-related tasks. It supports integrations for CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams, and is installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including support for polling and webhooks. The suite includes eight specialist skills specifically designed for the FLUX 3 video ecosystem and prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant agent skills by linking instructions to specific file lines or URLs. It automates the entire lifecycle of skill development, including briefing, creation, testing, and exporting.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the installation of reusable AI skills with support for recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, and incorporates commerce functionality through TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses a Rust binary and four core verbs—infer, invoke, exec, and agent—to define intent as code. It supports parallel execution of independent steps by utilizing dependency graphs to manage complex workflows.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks with autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety for long-running processes through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. it operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project utilizes a five-layer retrieval system, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By optimizing retrieval through RRF fusion, it reduces token usage and maintains functionality via graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly personal execution system, this project facilitates agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces through a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings produced in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python-based goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity environment provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, network analysis, and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, such as MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to agent workflows, providing memory between conversations and detecting state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy during local monitoring.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright for recording and ffmpeg for compression. It optimizes files to stay under 8 MB and automatically embeds the resulting markdown into the project README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills for integration with clients like Hermes and Cursor. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins, streamlining the expansion of agent capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs weekly to detect and report drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with specific runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators, operating locally using the Python standard library.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Designed for cross-environment compatibility, this skill manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax without requiring new software installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard, allowing Hermes Agent to handle paid resource requests programmatically.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized Chinese-language utilities, including Douyin video transcription to Markdown and rule-based removal of common AI writing patterns. It also features macOS-based OCR for structured data extraction and an e-commerce material studio.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the functional quality of agent skills by testing their structure and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with payments managed via dedicated wallet keys.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Cursor, and other AI agents.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This generator produces multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests and applies quality gates to generate structured action suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI-powered coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both open-source and unfree licensed tools. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to ensure users have access to the latest versions.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool utilizes a proot-distro Ubuntu environment to install Hermes Agent on Android devices through an automated Termux script. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and integration with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community-driven Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for the scheduling of tasks using cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell to restrict network and filesystem access at the kernel level. Users can define specific security policies to govern the agent's messaging capabilities and web search activities.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using Helm charts. It features a comprehensive credential catalog, integrations for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and supports persistent state through mounted home directories. It allows users to build specific Hermes versions by utilizing build arguments during the image creation process.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployments using declarative configurations for workspaces and settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes Agent to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, fundamental, and sentiment analysis to execute financial trading strategies. It ensures point-in-time data integrity during backtesting and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI or CLI. It supports local Node.js installation or Docker deployment, offering memory browsing and MCP server integration for workflow management.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages coding agents like Hermes and Claude using persistent tmux sessions for background execution and container-based isolation. It provides a TUI and web dashboard for overseeing Git worktree management and multi-agent coordination.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs across specialist teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes from single VPS agents to automated teams via a task bus delegation pattern. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It integrates with over 23 LLM providers and supports MCP tools to extend agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous tasks and a live stream of agent reasoning. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure quality and implementation standards.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a dedicated Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization tool automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena-style framework orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution, visualizing the competition through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It leverages Ollama for parallel model querying and synthesis without relying on cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports cross-file resolution for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust without requiring a Node.js runtime, integrating via MCP with agents like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility designed to track token consumption across multiple AI coding agents and IDEs. It features a terminal user interface and a 3D visualization dashboard, allowing users to submit data for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from various coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Cursor. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions and automatically redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from CLI tools. It supports over 37 AI tools and synchronizes usage data across multiple machines to track session details and account limits.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project provides an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art banners. Users can create and apply diverse aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk, using simple YAML-based configurations.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates commerce using USDC and SOL payments on Solana.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like LangGraph and CrewAI using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends support to various chat platforms and IDEs, including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring an automated installation process for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It supports 29 community plugins and is designed to get a zero-cost environment running in minutes using free models.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that identifies ambiguous tools and contract mismatches in AI agent configurations without requiring LLM calls or network access. It integrates with GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks to provide HERM v1.1 scoring for system prompts.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility maps OpenClaw configurations, skills, and memory archives into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the transition of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features zero-token passive analysis and scheduled active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue through Hermes Agent, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It utilizes specific contracts for opportunities and offer-previews, requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds a voice-enabled interface to Hermes Agent, featuring an open mic with wake-word support and adaptive turn-taking. It runs entirely offline in 35 languages using Piper and Kokoro, requiring no API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for adding, searching, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other command-line tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi serves as a local coworking application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities. It enables 24/7 automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI or various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote connections through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one place.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard facilitates multi-platform channel configuration for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It offers visual workflow building with human approval gates, scheduling, and detailed analytics for tracking token costs and model distribution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It includes fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a specialized kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports memory management and renders complex content like LaTeX and Markdown.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension links active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It allows users to toggle specific tabs for agent context and supports multi-agent group chats with synced conversation histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that connects directly to a self-hosted server without third-party relays. It enables mobile management of agent chats, scheduled tasks, skills, and server-side files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session quota burn and estimated API costs across 15 agents. It allows users to search local prompts and tool calls while providing the ability to resume supported CLI sessions in Terminal, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile-first dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via embedded Python and Node.js runtimes without requiring installation or admin rights. It features a Tkinter GUI and includes 100 tools for tasks such as TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
